title: Figure 7: Histology and electrode tracks - Nissl-stained coronal brain sections
description: Microscope images titled "Sample slices from all implants" showing purple Nissl-stained coronal brain sections labeled D1 Left through D4 Right with black lines and arrows marking electrode tracks (e.g., "Electrode 5," "Electrode 8"). A right-hand column of seven sections labeled "Multiple slices from D4 Left" is arranged by depth from 0 to 1000µm, with a small stack schematic. The caption "Figure 7. Histology and Electrode Tracks" notes the black line marks the boundary between upper and lower layers (Reference 47).
